_comment: Single source of truth for the codex-acp approval-decoupling anchor (D-008 amendment, 2026-07-31). Consumed by codex-acp-patch.ts (the runner image, via scripts/patch-codex-acp-approvals.ts) AND by services/runner/images/sandbox/daytona/build_snapshot.py (the Daytona snapshot image). Both surfaces MUST patch identically, or a Daytona run silently keeps cold approvals while a local run is warm. Keep the anchor here and nowhere else.
